content_sections.heading: IGNCA Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: IGNCA has announced vacancies for Project Manager, Project Coordinator and Assistant posts under the Conservation Division.

content_sections.heading: IGNCA Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Postgraduate degree in Conservation, Archaeology, Heritage Management or History. Minimum 5 years of professional experience in conservation and management of Ladakhi heritage. Experience in handling conservation projects related to wall paintings, Thangka paintings, traditional architecture, museum and heritage documentation. Age Limit: 40 years. Postgraduate degree in Conservation, Archaeology or Heritage Management. Minimum 3 years of experience in heritage conservation projects, documentation, archaeological fieldwork or project coordination. Age Limit: 40 years. Senior Secondary qualification. Practical skills in one or more areas including historic textile restoration, book binding, traditional fabrics, Thangka conservation and preventive conservation. Age Limit: 50 years.

content_sections.heading: IGNCA Recruitment 2026 Contract Period
content_sections.text: The appointment will initially be for a period of one year and may be extended based on project requirements and satisfactory performance.

content_sections.heading: IGNCA Apply Process 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates are required to appear for the walk-in interview at IGNCA Centre, Department of Archives, Archaeology and Museum, UT Ladakh.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IGNCA Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Download and fill the prescribed application form. Prepare an updated resume. Carry self-attested copies of academic marksheets and experience certificates. Carry original and photocopy of identity proof. Report at the interview venue on 09 September 2026 before the reporting time.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents for IGNCA Walk-in Interview
content_sections.text: Filled application form Updated Resume/CV Academic marksheets from 10th onwards Experience certificates Aadhaar Card/PAN Card/Voter ID/Driving License Original documents for verification

content_sections.heading: IGNCA Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process varies according to the post: Project Manager and Project Coordinator: Walk-in Interview Assistant: Practical Test and Interview

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must report on time for document verification. Only eligible candidates will be allowed to appear for the interview. Selected candidates have to submit reference letters/testimonials from previous employer, organization or institution at the time of joining. The engagement is purely contractual.

faq.question: Q1. What is IGNCA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: IGNCA Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive by Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts for contractual engagement of Project Manager, Project Coordinator and Assistant posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IGNCA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 15 vacancies are available, including 2 Project Manager posts, 1 Project Coordinator post and 12 Assistant posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the IGNCA Recruitment 2026 interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted on 09 September 2026 at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of IGNCA Project Manager?
faq.answer: Project Manager candidates will receive remuneration of Rs. 70,000 to Rs. 80,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for IGNCA Project Coordinator post?
faq.answer: Candidates should have a postgraduate degree in Conservation, Archaeology or Heritage Management with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for IGNCA Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Assistant posts is 50 years.
